desc.testo: Extra Space Storage Inc. is an American real estate investment trust headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah that invests in self storage facilities. The company rents storage units, including climate controlled units, drive-up units, lockers, boat storage, RV storage and business storage under the brands Extra Space Storage, Life Storage, and Storage Express.
desc.trad: Extra Space Storage Inc. è un fondo di investimento immobiliare americano con sede a Salt Lake City, Utah, che investe in strutture di self storage. L'azienda noleggia unità di stoccaggio, comprese unità climatizzate, unità drive-up, armadietti, rimessaggio barche, deposito camper e deposito aziendale con i marchi Extra Space Storage, Life Storage e Storage Express.
